title: Lab 02 — Cookie Consent: Tracking, Choices & a Banner That Won't Sit Still

variants.hint: Were you listening to the network BEFORE the visitor chose anything? Start recording requests before page.goto().
variants.debrief: Analytics loaded on page load, before any choice -- the classic GDPR defect. Only a test that records requests from the very first navigation, and asserts 'none yet' before clicking, can see it.

variants.hint: Reject looked fine... on that page. What does R3 say about reloading?
variants.debrief: Reject never saved the choice, so the banner returned on the next page view. Choices that must persist need a reload (or a new page in the same context) in the test.

variants.hint: After Reject, is the network really silent? Count every tracking request, not just the analytics script.
variants.debrief: Rejecting sent one '/collect?e=consent_rejected' ping -- tracking the rejection itself. Assert that the list of tracking requests after Reject is exactly empty.

variants.hint: Did your cart test ever actually meet the banner? If you pre-seeded consent, the banner never appeared -- R5 is about shopping WITH the banner in play.
variants.debrief: Dismissing the banner re-rendered the page and silently unhooked the Add-to-cart button. Pre-seeding consent is great for tests that aren't about the banner -- and it also hides every bug that only happens when the banner is there. page.addLocatorHandler() lets the banner appear and deals with it.
